zh: 以防下雨，你记得带伞。
old_en: In case it rains, remember to bring an umbrella.
new_en: Bring an umbrella in case it rains.

zh: 以防天气变坏，你记得带伞。
old_en: In case the weather gets bad, remember to bring an umbrella.
new_en: Bring an umbrella in case the weather turns bad.

zh: 以防忘记，出门前检查一下带钥匙了没。
old_en: In case you forget, check if you have your keys before leaving.
new_en: Check if you have your keys before leaving in case you forget.

zh: 以防被锁在门外，出门前确认带了钥匙。
old_en: In case you get locked out, make sure you have your keys before leaving.
new_en: Make sure you have your keys before leaving in case you get locked out.

zh: 以防路上堵车，提前留出时间。
old_en: In case there's traffic on the road, leave early and allow extra time.
new_en: Leave extra time in case there is traffic on the road.

zh: 以防遇到交通堵塞，早点出门。
old_en: In case you run into traffic, leave early.
new_en: Leave early in case you encounter a traffic jam.

zh: 以防丢失，备份一份重要文件。
old_en: To be safe, make a copy of the important file in case you lose it.
new_en: Back up an important document in case it gets lost.

zh: 以防电脑故障，备份重要文件。
old_en: To be safe, make a backup of the important files in case the computer breaks down.
new_en: Back up important files in case the computer breaks down.

zh: 以防计划有变，准备一个备用方案。
old_en: To be safe, prepare an alternative plan in case the schedule changes.
new_en: Prepare a backup plan in case your schedule changes.

zh: 以防出现意外情况，提前准备好备用计划。
old_en: To be safe, prepare a backup plan in case something unexpected happens.
new_en: Have a backup plan ready in case something unexpected happens.

zh: 以防万一找不到我，记得存我的电话号码。
old_en: To be safe, remember to save my phone number in case you can't find me.
new_en: Save my phone number in case you can't find me.

zh: 以防找不到地方，把地址记下来。
old_en: In case I can't find the place, write down the address as a precaution.
new_en: Write down the address in case you can't find the place.

zh: 以防走错路，把地址提前记好。
old_en: In case I take a wrong turn, write down the address beforehand as a precaution.
new_en: Write down the address beforehand in case you take a wrong turn.

zh: 以防下雨，出门前查一下天气预报。
old_en: Check the weather forecast before going out in case it rains.
new_en: Check the weather forecast before going out in case it rains.

zh: 以防天气变冷，出发前查一下温度。
old_en: Check the temperature before leaving in case it gets cold.
new_en: Check the temperature before leaving in case it gets cold.

zh: 以防以后联系不到，提醒对方存下电话号码。
old_en: In case they can't get in touch later, remind them to save the phone number.
new_en: Remind them to save the phone number in case you can't contact them later.

zh: 以防身体不适，带一点常用药。
old_en: In case I feel unwell, I'll bring some common medicine.
new_en: Bring some common medicine in case you feel unwell.

zh: 以防生病，带点常用药在身边。
old_en: In case I get sick, I carry some common medicine with me.
new_en: Keep some common medicine with you in case you get sick.

zh: 以防手机没电，出门前把手机充满电。
old_en: Before leaving, charge your phone fully in case it runs out of battery.
new_en: Charge your phone fully before leaving in case it runs out of battery.

zh: 以防在路上手机没电，出门前记得把手机充满。
old_en: In case the phone runs out of power on the way, remember to charge it fully before leaving.
new_en: Remember to charge your phone fully before leaving in case it dies on the way.
